items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Then I went with Count Basie -- a couple of times. You know? Two or three times.

ctx.x: Yeah. Abie Baker. And he recommended me to her. So I stayed with her for about, oh, I guess, three or four years [1933-36]; three or four years, and then I joined Claude Hopkins, and I worked with Claude for about three or four years [1936-39]. Then I went with Benny Carter for a year or so [1939], a couple of years maybe. Then I was with... Then I went with Count Basie -- a couple of times. You know? Two or three times.
You mean you would leave and come back?
